articles.title: How 3 Italians took flight from India sans immigration check: hub-spoke model, govt action explained
articles.description: How could three Italians take flights from two Indian airports and reach their international destination without clearing mandatory immigration? This question is gripping India's aviation sector after a show-cause notice was issued to Air India over the Italian nationals flying from Amritsar to Delhi on an Air India flight in the early hours of September 4. They were then scheduled to travel onward from Delhi to Munich on Lufthansa flight LH-763. But there was a problem. The Ministry says the three passengers left India on the Lufthansa flight without undergoing mandatory departure immigration clearance. Here's what happened, how the government reacted, and what happens next. Watch the full video for more.

articles.title: Is Xi Jinping In Hospital? Modi’s Concern, Missed Dinner, And Helicopter Claim Fuel Questions
articles.description: Is China hiding the truth about Xi Jinping’s health? India became the stage for a fresh wave of rumours after Xi appeared uncomfortable during the BRICS Summit and skipped Prime Minister Modi’s gala dinner. A dissident source later alleged that Xi was taken to Beijing’s 301 Military Hospital by helicopter. The claim remains unverified. No official confirmation has emerged from China or India. Xi did attend the summit, met Modi and completed the published programme. Yet China’s opaque leadership system means even a small unexplained moment can trigger speculation about succession, military control and policy stability. This report examines what happened in Delhi, what is being claimed and what the available evidence actually proves.
